description: Work out the longest home loan tenure MAS allows for private residential property in Singapore: the lesser of 30 years and (65 minus age). For a joint application, also give the second borrower and it uses the income-weighted average age. From Propely (propely.sg), the owner-direct condo marketplace in Singapore. Indicative figures, not legal or financial advice.

borrower1Age.description: Age of the (first) borrower in years

borrower1Income.description: First borrower income used for the loan (weights the joint average age)

borrower2Age.description: Age of the second borrower; leave out for a single applicant

borrower2Income.description: Second borrower income used for the loan (weights the joint average age)

name: max_loan_tenure
title: Singapore maximum home loan tenure
